entities.name: Query LeuRS
observations: 768-aa protein with Pfam tRNA-synt_1 family domains spanning the catalytic core.
Contains class-I aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase HIGH and KMSKS signature regions inferred from strong homology.
Best reviewed homologs are cytosolic leucine--tRNA ligases with EC 6.1.1.4.

entities.name: Leu-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: tRNA(Leu) + L-leucine + ATP = L-leucyl-tRNA(Leu) + AMP + diphosphate.
Reaction is mapped to Rhea:11688 and associated with EC 6.1.1.4 leucine--tRNA ligase activity.

entities.name: Q7M926
observations: Reviewed Wolinella succinogenes leucine--tRNA ligase; 100% sequence identity and 100% query coverage to the analyzed sequence.
Annotated with EC 6.1.1.4, Rhea:11688, cytosolic localization, ATP binding, and leucyl-tRNA aminoacylation.
